usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.admin.organization.users.retrieve("user_id")
pp result

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `organization.user`

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints

fields.name: email
fields.description: The email address of the user

fields.name: added_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the user was added.

fields.name: is_default
fields.description: Whether this is the organization's default user.

fields.name: created
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the user was created.

fields.name: is_service_account
fields.description: Whether the user is a service account.

fields.name: is_scale_tier_authorized_purchaser
fields.description: Whether the user is an authorized purchaser for Scale Tier.

fields.name: is_scim_managed
fields.description: Whether the user is managed through SCIM.

fields.name: api_key_last_used_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of the user's last API key usage.

fields.name: technical_level
fields.description: The technical level metadata for the user.

fields.name: developer_persona
fields.description: The developer persona metadata for the user.

fields.name: projects
fields.description: Projects associated with the user, if included.
